source_caption:
The heartbreaking exchange between Casey Affleck and Michelle Williams in Manchester by the Sea was shot in long, uninterrupted takes, allowing the actors to play the scene almost like theater. Director Kenneth Lonergan avoided cutting away so the raw emotion could build naturally, making the moment feel painfully real.

Manchester by the Sea (2016), directed by Kenneth Lonergan, starring Casey Affleck, Michelle Williams, Lucas Hedges. A devastating and deeply human drama about loss, guilt, and the impossibility of moving on, told through quiet moments that carry overwhelming emotional weight.

source_details.title: Manchester by the Sea
source_details.synopsis: Manchester by the Sea is a 2016 American drama film written and directed by Kenneth Lonergan that stars Casey Affleck, Michelle Williams, Kyle Chandler, and Lucas Hedges. Revolving around the themes of depression, guilt, grief, responsibility, dysfunctional families, and post-traumatic stress disorder, the plot follows a depressed and grief-stricken man who becomes the legal guardian of his teenage nephew after the death of his brother. The film premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 23, 2016, and was picked up by Amazon Studios for distribution.
